7.4.2.2.8 FrameID
[SWS_Mirror_00095]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Mirror_00008
⌈The FrameID shall provide the identification of the source frame. This identification
shall be unique for one source bus identified by NetworkType and NetworkID. The
FrameID may be omitted when reporting a source bus state change, the presence
shall be indicated by FrameIDAvailable.⌋
[SWS_Mirror_00096]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Mirror_00008
⌈The width and layout of the FrameID field is bus specific and is defined separately for
each bus as FrameIDCAN, FrameIDLIN, and FrameIDFlexRay.⌋
